notes: CHILD-AFTER-DEATH FLAG CONTEXT (folding in this repo's deep-chain credibility audit, 2026-07-04): Frederick Tylney and wife Elizabeth Say are the real, documented parents of Elizabeth Tilney, Countess of Surrey (b.1445/46 Ashwellthorpe, Norfolk) - see Wikipedia: Elizabeth Tilney, Countess of Surrey. The specific child-after-death flag (Edmund Howard b.1478, this record's death 1447) was not independently re-verified this pass; Edmund Howard is a real grandson of Elizabeth Tilney via her second marriage (per the corrected genealogy in manual notes on I182625982211), so if this record is genuinely Edmund's grandfather rather than father the relationship-generation may simply be mislabeled in the tree rather than the death date being wrong.
